fact: ICASEES, the national statistics institute, runs an Open Data Portal (ODP) at work, with a national workshop planned for end-June 2026 to update its indicators ahead of an ODIN assessment in mid-August 2026; no dataset count is given.
ICASEES confirmed at a regional meeting that a new open licence is integrated on its Open Data portal and institutional website.

ICASEES's NADA platform offers microdata, databases, questionnaires and metadata for download, per the ICASEES focal point's question at a 21 May 2026 AfDB and Open Data Watch webinar; the document says NADA has no licence of its own.

ICASEES's Director General described its digital dissemination ecosystem as including the Portail Open Data (ODP RCA) and the NADA data archive portal, and the ODIN/ODP administrator reported more than fifty indicators updated on ICASEES platforms; no licence or dataset count is given.

The IMF reports that CAR launched its National Summary Data Page, a one-stop portal disseminating macroeconomic data (national accounts, prices, government operations, debt, monetary and external sectors) compiled by multiple statistical agencies, hosted by ICASEES with BEAC and the Ministry of Finance and Budget; no licence or dataset count is given.
ICASEES's education data page offers yearbook and key-indicator files for download, each marked licence CC BY 4.0.
The country launched about two weeks before 5 June 2025 a new data portal, the National Summary Data Page (PNRD), publishing key macroeconomic and financial data.

The Central African statistics institute ICASEES says that on its ODIN RCA space each indicator now offers direct access to data in CSV, JSON and SDMX, and that its open data portal ODP 1.0 gives access to statistical datasets.
